text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having gained valuable experience across 
numerous races, Neo Universe built a solid 
career that paved the way for next year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe finally speaks of another 
hidden objective— the existence of the 
"GATE."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That "GATE" was the Tenno Sho (Spring). 
The wall that Neo Universe had to 
overcome. She knew she had to go beyond 
it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring) is a prestigious 
long-distance race. To conquer it, she 
chooses the orthodox path, setting her 
next goal on the Satsuki Sho.
